content: ऋषभः [ऋष्-अभक्; <ls>Uṇ. 3. 123</ls>] .²1 A bull. .²2 (With names of other animals) the male animal, as अजर्षभः a goat. .²3 The best or most excellent (as the last member of a <ab>comp.</ab>); as पुरुषर्षभः, भरतर्षभः <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 The second of the seven notes of the gamut; (said to be uttered by cows; गावस्त्वृषभभाषिणः); श्रुतिसमधिकमुच्चैः पञ्चमं पीडयन्तः सततमृषभहीनं भिन्नकीकृत्य षड्जम् <ls>Śi. 11. 1</ls>; ऋषभोऽत्र गीयत इति <ls>Āryā. S. 141</ls>. .²5 The hollow of the ear. .²6 A boarʼs tail. .²7 A crocodileʼs tail. .²8 A dried plant, one of the 8 principal medicaments. (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बैलघाटी, काकडाशिंगी</ns>) .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of an antidote. .²10 An incarnation of Viṣṇu; नाभेरसावृषभ आस सुदेविसूनुः <ls>Bhāg. 2. 7. 10</ls>. .²11 A sacrifice (to be performed by kings). .{@-भाः@} {%m.%} The inhabitants of क्रौञ्चद्वीप; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 20. 22</ls>. .{@-भी@} .²1 A woman with masculine features (as a beard <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 A cow. .²3 A widow. .²4 The plant Carpopogon Pruriens (शूकशिंवी); also another plant (शिराला) (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कुयली</ns>)
